findings.description: Critical: The unavailable-audit branch collapses two distinct F6 cases into `SKIP_REASON="audit-choices not installed"`: the skill missing and the harness exposing no sub-agent dispatch tool. For the no-dispatch-tool case, the required single warning does not name the actual reason, so the scenario's `log a single warning naming the reason` requirement is not satisfied.
findings.resolution: Split the availability check into separate outcomes, e.g. `audit-choices not installed` when the skill directory/runtime mirror is absent and `no sub-agent dispatch tool` when dispatch is unavailable. Add a workflow-hook content assertion that pins both reasons.
